¿Qué son los hornos de secado y curado?: What are drying and curing ovens?
Los hornos de secado y curado son equipo:
Drying and curing ovens apply controlled heat to remove moisture from a surface or part after pretreatment and to harden or stabilize coatings and other materials.

During drying, the oven evaporates water or pretreatment residue. During curing, heat drives the chemical or physical changes required for the coating to develop its specified properties.

Precise control of temperature, airflow, and dwell time allows each oven to match the process window and material specification.
Las operaciones de manufactura de alto v: High-volume manufacturing operations often face heat-process inefficiencies that increase cost per part and affect final finish quality.
